statistical_scope.cluster: four passages per corpus; starts/arms/views/metrics/contrasts share indices
statistical_scope.primary: Eight fixed D/factorial estimands x later signed NLL x eight source/start strata; all64 reported; joint equals center_main+direction_pair_main, no any-one-CI success rule.
statistical_scope.multiplicity: Nominal conditional95% intervals, unadjusted and correlated; no fit/population uncertainty or independent-replication interpretation.
statistical_scope.numerical_scope: Signed canonical FP32 KL retained. Selected R saved-logit FP64 diagnostics are not a whole-panel precision/sensitivity bound.
statistical_scope.limits: Finite center/direction-pair operations at unequal natural cell doses; changing basis also changes orth control. Same-text calibration, no intrinsic-PC, equivalence, population or method-priority claim.

scope.norm_semantics: Center FIRST, direction-pair SECOND. Each cell targets its own min full write norm; across-cell effects include unequal natural doses.
scope.evidence: Runtime protected-region/closure flags and fingerprints are not independent raw reconstruction. Compact18-state write/readout panel requires separate N/P/R audits; common native input is shared once.
scope.small_KL: Signed FP32 metrics unchanged; selected saved-logit FP64 R diagnostics cannot bound unsaved rows or establish sensitivity at1e-6 from a1e-4 consistency PASS.
scope.primary: All64 finite co-primary comparisons reported; no any-one-CI study-success rule.
